name: Create Task in Asana
description: Creates a task in Asana with optional project and section assignment. Handles the multi-step pattern: create task, then optionally add it to a specific section within the project.

workspaceGid.description: Workspace GID where the task will be created

projectGid.description: Project GID to add the task to

sectionGid.description: Section GID to place the task in (requires projectGid)

htmlNotes.description: Task description (HTML). Overrides notes if both provided.

tags.description: Array of tag GIDs to apply

steps.name: Create the task via Asana API
